title: Barry and Teri Volpert Visiting Professor of Practice in Private Equity
bio: From 2007 through 2023, David Sorkin served as General Counsel and then Chief Legal Officer of KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE: “KKR”), a global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions.
